constraints.statement: Keep all items, supplier offers, mappings, forms and history private to the owning organization.
No supplier discovery, consumer/supplier interaction, supplier selection, binding quotation, ordering or payment in v1.
Support any industry from launch; use renovation as the first configuration and proving journey.
Dutch, English, French and German support covers admin, published forms, item labels, classifications and result PDFs.
Deliver a full hosted app first and website embedding next within launch scope; allow separate admin/calculator hosting.
Published revisions and saved snapshots preserve historical monetary and linguistic meaning; no public supplier leakage.
Exclude unresolved/incompatible supplier rows and visibly mark selected items lacking eligible prices; never silently produce a complete zero-priced line.

founding_decisions.title: Separate Catalog, Calculator Design and Estimation
founding_decisions.question: Where do item meaning, published calculator configuration and historical results belong?
founding_decisions.recommended_option: Use three explicit domain boundaries in an initially modular application, with modules inside each context.
alternatives: Keep all behavior in one cohesive context until independent ownership emerges.
Deploy separate business services for catalog, authoring and estimates.
founding_decisions.rationale: Imported mutable supply data, published recipes and immutable estimate results have different language and lifecycle; hosting differences alone do not create business contexts.
consequences: Requires three versioned consumer-owned read bridges.
Avoid independent service operations until workload or ownership proves the need.
Split supplier management only when its lifecycle becomes independent.

founding_decisions.title: Pin published revisions and preserve estimate meaning
founding_decisions.question: How can imports, translations, publication and estimate history remain coherent without cross-context atomic writes?
founding_decisions.recommended_option: Catalog creates immutable reviewed revisions; Calculator Design atomically activates a recipe that pins catalog/content revisions; Estimation reads those exact revisions and locally saves the result.
alternatives: Resolve latest accepted catalog revision once at submission and pin it only in the result.
Copy catalog data into each calculator release through a coordinated publication process.
founding_decisions.rationale: Explicit publication and immutable saved results need stable interpretation even when prices or translations later change.
consequences: Accepted price changes require a new calculator activation before public use under this proposal.
Cross-context dependencies are read-only; only the owning context writes its data.
Missing revisions fail visibly; retention must preserve references until dependent results can stand alone.

founding_decisions.title: Share calculator behavior across hosted and embedded delivery
founding_decisions.question: How should one calculator support a full web app, embedding and independent admin hosting?
founding_decisions.recommended_option: Keep public calculator execution and domain contracts shared; separate admin/public web composition, with one hosted app delivered first and an isolated embed adapter delivered next within launch scope.
alternatives: Build separate standalone and embedded calculator implementations.
Distribute a host-page widget that shares the customer's page styling and runtime.
founding_decisions.rationale: E6 requires both modes at launch in sequence and allows separate admin hosting; shared execution avoids divergence in quantities, prices and localized results.
consequences: Embedding transport, origins, resizing/accessibility and browser behavior require an architecture compatibility spike.
Public use cannot require the admin session; admin retains the managed BFF profile.

founding_decisions.title: Use managed mechanisms without transferring business ownership
founding_decisions.question: Which responsibilities belong to reusable Forms/Localization mechanisms versus this product?
founding_decisions.recommended_option: Adapt Orbyss Forms and Localization through owned Catalog/Calculator Design modules; keep item, quantity, price, language meaning, publication and snapshot rules in consumer contexts.
alternatives: Implement custom form editing/rendering and localization mechanisms.
Adopt a third-party hosted form service and translate its contracts into the same domain model.
founding_decisions.rationale: The installed capability catalog declares these mechanisms, while the product's generic industry semantics and price ownership remain explicit.
consequences: Architecture must verify renderer/backend/storage and package compatibility before selection.
Authentication uses the applicable managed BFF default for admin, independent of anonymous embedding.
If .NET is selected, the managed external Foundation.Host default applies; no user stack preference is invented.

founding_decisions.title: Preserve organization and consumer visibility boundaries
founding_decisions.question: How should central administration coexist with public no-account estimates?
founding_decisions.recommended_option: All authoring and supplier records remain scoped to an organization; Estimation exposes a separate consumer-safe projection while admins access authorized saved snapshots.
alternatives: Dedicated application/database deployments for every organization.
Shared public supplier/catalog records with customer-specific filters.
founding_decisions.rationale: Users explicitly selected private organization data, public basic estimation and no supplier-consumer interaction.
consequences: Organization/resource authorization applies in every context, import and historical lookup.
Download access without an account needs an explicit bounded access design.
Physical data isolation and provisioning are architecture/deployment choices, not inferred shared-data permission.

subdomains.non_ownership: Does not own supplier product codes or estimate arithmetic.

subdomains.name: Supplier Data Acquisition
subdomains.vision: Turn supplier spreadsheets into traceable comparable offers.
subdomains.ownership: Supplier entities, code mappings, review and eligible prices.
subdomains.non_ownership: Does not select suppliers for consumers.
invariants: Unresolved mappings cannot silently influence estimates.

subdomains.name: Guided Calculator Modeling
subdomains.vision: Express an industry's estimation journey through reusable configuration.
subdomains.ownership: Branches, item selections, quantity rules, classification labels and release meaning.
subdomains.non_ownership: Does not own generic form-renderer source.
invariants: Renovation is configuration, not a hard-coded product limit.

subdomains.name: Organization Publishing
subdomains.vision: Publish private organization configuration as branded public calculators.
subdomains.ownership: Branding, calculator identity, language content and publication/distribution settings.
subdomains.non_ownership: Does not create a supplier marketplace.
invariants: Public publication exposes only approved consumer-facing data.

subdomains.name: Authentication, Forms and Localization Mechanisms
subdomains.vision: Use reusable authentication, rendering, editing and language delivery machinery.
subdomains.ownership: Technical mechanisms mediated by domain-owned adapters.
subdomains.non_ownership: Does not own customer permissions, pricing, item language or publication semantics.
invariants: Mechanism adoption never transfers consumer business ownership.

subdomains.name: Budget Estimation
subdomains.vision: Convert selected items and quantities into useful indicative budget ranges.
subdomains.ownership: Aggregation, completeness, total-range classification and immutable result meaning.
subdomains.non_ownership: Does not promise a binding quote or a jointly available supplier bundle.
invariants: Total endpoints sum eligible line endpoints; unknown prices remain explicit.

subdomains.name: Result Review and Export
subdomains.vision: Make an estimate usable after submission without exposing suppliers.
subdomains.ownership: Admin history, consumer projections and PDF rendering from saved results.
subdomains.non_ownership: Does not silently recalculate old results.
invariants: Consumer exports contain no supplier identities.

contracts.name: Maintain Items and Translated Labels
contracts.description: Validate and save organization-owned item definitions, hierarchy, units, typed properties and four-language labels. Catalog owns write atomicity and errors.

contracts.name: Review and Accept Supplier Excel
contracts.description: Stage a supplied workbook, map supplier codes, preview validation, resolve issues and accept a new reviewed catalog revision. Failure leaves the prior eligible revision intact.

contracts.name: Supplier Excel Delivery
contracts.description: An offline supplier sheet carries supplier product codes and item/offer properties for administrator import; it grants no supplier app access in v1.

contracts.name: Read Catalog Revision
contracts.description: Read organization-scoped item definitions, normalized reviewed offers and localized labels by exact immutable revision; a missing revision is a visible failure.

contracts.name: Configure Calculator and Translations
contracts.description: Save private calculator draft identity, brand, branches, item references, quantity rules, total bands and Dutch/English/French/German content. Writes belong to Calculator Design.

contracts.name: Validate Preview and Publish Calculator
contracts.description: Validate item references against an immutable catalog revision and pin content/recipe versions. Activate a release locally only after validation; failed publication preserves the current release.

contracts.name: Read Published Calculator
contracts.description: Return immutable public recipe, brand and localized labels by calculator/release identity; supplier data and admin information are excluded.

contracts.name: Catalog References for Calculator Design
contracts.description: Consumer-owned query translates same-organization immutable catalog definitions and revision identity for draft lookup and publication validation; performs no Catalog write.

contracts.name: Published Recipe for Estimation
contracts.description: Consumer-owned query resolves one immutable execution recipe with quantity/band rules, localization and the exact catalog revision; missing or foreign releases fail visibly.

contracts.name: Comparable Offers for Estimation
contracts.description: Consumer-owned server-side query translates exact same-organization catalog revision offers into evaluation inputs. Supplier identity is private and never included in public output.

contracts.name: Submit and Calculate Estimate
contracts.description: Validate answers against the published release, resolve quantities and eligible prices, calculate endpoints/optional mean/bands, mark missing prices and save a snapshot before reporting success.

contracts.name: Save Historical Estimate
contracts.description: Atomically save owner-local answers, selected items, quantities, labels, calculation/catalog/release references and displayed prices. Persistence failure cannot report a saved estimate.

contracts.name: View Consumer Estimate
contracts.description: Return selected items, quantities, localized price range, optional mean, classifications and completeness from the submitted snapshot, excluding suppliers and private offers.

contracts.name: Review Organization Estimate
contracts.description: Authenticated organization admins retrieve historical snapshots with organization/resource authorization; later prices and text do not change saved results.

contracts.name: Download Estimate PDF
contracts.description: Render a consumer-safe PDF from the authorized submitted snapshot without account/email requirement, supplier identities or live recalculation. Exact download access control is assigned to feature design.

contracts.name: Get and Install Published Calculator Embed
contracts.description: Return publication configuration for an existing organization's calculator to its website publisher; the same public recipe and estimation service support hosted and embedded use.

contracts.name: Accept Reviewed Supplier Offers
contracts.description: Accept a validated staged import with resolved mappings as a new owner-local immutable offer revision. Failure leaves the prior eligible revision intact.

contracts.name: Edit or Import Calculator Translations
contracts.description: Validate and save Dutch, English, French and German form, brand and band text in the calculator draft. This is a write operation owned by Calculator Design; publication remains separate.

capability_bindings.semantic_profile: Own quantity execution, comparable-price eligibility, min/max/mean aggregation, total-range percentage bands and missing-price completeness.
capability_bindings.provider_selection: Project-owned deterministic estimator; bounded rule mechanism defined in feature specification.

capability_bindings.semantic_profile: Own immutable answers, selected items, quantities, historical labels, totals and revision references; admin retrieval cannot silently recalculate.
capability_bindings.provider_selection: Durable consumer-owned persistence; architecture selects provider and owner-local atomicity.

capability_bindings.semantic_profile: Own historical consumer-safe output and access policy; account/email are not prerequisites and supplier details are excluded.
capability_bindings.provider_selection: PDF renderer and download mechanism assigned to architecture/result feature.

capability_bindings.semantic_profile: Downstream-owned queries translate exact recipe and catalog revisions; upstream retains data ownership and Estimation owns submission consistency/failure handling.
capability_bindings.provider_selection: Consumer bridges; no cross-context store access or atomic writes.
